subject: general
question: The third battle of Panipat was fought in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is **1761**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Third Battle of Panipat was fought on 14 January 1761.
 
• The battle was fought between the Maratha Empire and the Durrani Empire (Afghan Empire) led by Ahmad Shah Abdali.
 
• The battle is one of the largest and bloodiest fought in the 18th century, resulting in a decisive victory for Ahmad Shah Abdali.
 
• The defeat weakened the Maratha Empire, paving the way for the British East India Company to expand its influence in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Details
 
 
 
 

 Location
 Panipat, a historic town in Haryana, India.
 
 

 Combatants
 Maratha Empire vs. Durrani Empire.
 
 

 Significance
 Marked the end of Maratha ascendancy and the beginning of British dominance in India.
 
 

 Casualties
 One of the highest casualties in any battle in the 18th century.
 
 

 Outcome
 Decisive victory for Ahmad Shah Abdali.
